annotations.title: Wallet positions at a past time

description: Exact perp positions one Hyperliquid wallet held at a past moment, up to 90 days back: market, side, signed size, mark price and notional at that moment, plus today's size and how many fills it made since. Built from Hyperliquid's live positions minus the wallet's fills after that moment, so sizes are exact across native and HIP-3 perps. Needs a free API key; how far back you can go follows the key's history window. Use it for questions like 'what was this wallet holding before the crash'. For positions right now use get_user_state; for trades in between use get_fills.

at.description: The past moment: ISO 8601 (2026-11-01T12:00:00Z), unix seconds or unix milliseconds
